outcome: Bacterial species correlation with PE onset
cohort: The study included thirty age-matched normotensive and early-onset pre-eclamptic women, as well as age-matched normotensive and late-onset pre-eclamptic women.
finding: The study found a low biomass of bacterial species in placental samples and no significant correlation between the placental bacterial composition and early- or late-onset pre-eclampsia.
cross-section timing: At the time of birth (when placental tissues were obtained)
